patterns.key_values: NSTableView with column headers (Name/From/To/Size/Saving/Status/Fi..), 1px vertical header separators, zebra striping (~4% gray alt rows), ~28pt-class single-line rows, leading checkbox select column, per-row live pop-up button in 'To' cell, trailing share glyph
minimal titlebar — coloured traffic lights leading + centred 2-segment Convert|Compress mode switch; no visible trailing group (cropped)
bottom action bar — leading add-glyph + secondary status text ('20 images ready. Drag more images to add them.'), trailing quiet 'Again' + filled royal-blue 'Convert' primary anchored bottom-right

signature_moves: The table cell IS the control — every row's 'To' cell is a live pop-up button, turning the NSTableView into an inline bulk-configuration ledger (Name -> From -> To) with one terminal Convert, instead of a modal per-file wizard

One hardcoded royal-blue (#1B5BFF core / ~#3670F6 UI) carries the entire identity — deliberately not the system blue, tying window accent -> icon marble -> marketing shards into one recognisable hue against an otherwise strictly-neutral white/gray table
Verdict: competent-but-almost-anonymous — strip the blue and it is the default AppKit table an Xcode template hands you; no depth system, no custom type, no spatial flourish
defects: Contrast Dilution — secondary metadata (From tags, 'Waiting' status) ~#888 on #FFF ~= 3.5:1, below 4.5:1 AA; the columns you actually scan are the quietest text on screen
Non-system accent binding (native tell #6) — brand royal-blue overrides controlAccentColor on pop-up wells + primary; internally consistent house style but not learned as canon
Accent repetition (minor) — ~20 accent-blue chevron wells stipple the table, thinning the Von-Restorff pop of the single Convert CTA (not Focal Collision — wells are not filled competing CTAs)

Segmented control as top-level mode nav (borderline, native tell #7) — Convert|Compress switches primary modes; rule reserves segmented for in-view scope, mitigated as a common titlebar-accessory pattern over one workflow
Faint UI borders (#10 marginal) — checkbox/hairline separators <3:1 on white (estimated)

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product applied natively — light neutral ramp (white/#F4F5F5/#F6F7F8) + one electric royal-blue accent; disciplined single-accent-on-neutral (not the warm-editorial default). Marketing skin is a separate Swiss/International composite (heavy black grotesk, near-white/near-black, hard blue diagonal shards)

psychology: Jakob's Law (exploited) — spreadsheet-table + traffic-light chrome is instantly legible; users arrive knowing how a column-header file list behaves
Von Restorff / signal-detection (exploited then partly spent) — single filled royal-blue Convert is the one thing the eye finds, but ~20 blue chevron wells dilute that pop
Hick's Law + Tesler's Law (well-absorbed) — irreducible per-file 'what should this become?' compressed to one pop-up per row; system infers From, user picks only To, one button commits the batch
Fitts's Law (exploited) — Convert primary is large and pinned to the bottom-right corner, an effectively oversized target at a screen corner
Processing fluency (mild friction) — low-contrast secondary metadata works against the fluency the clean table otherwise sets up
notes: SOURCE LIMITATION: meta.json ships empty gallery/shots — the ONLY UI evidence is the app window composited into the marketing cover.png, at an indeterminate render scale (not a captured retina screenshot). All pixel/size tokens are (estimated) as pt-classes, not measured pt; only the 2400x1260 cover aspect is (measured). The window bleeds off the right edge (final 'Fi..' column + any trailing toolbar controls cropped). No row is shown selected and no focus ring is visible, so native-audit #3 (selection grammar) and rubric #14 (focus appearance) are UNOBSERVED, not passed. Lineage is confidently native-AppKit (real NSTableView, pop-up buttons, segmented control, traffic lights, 13pt-class density); era is confidently big-sur/pre-Tahoe (rounded-rect-not-capsule controls, Big-Sur blue-gradient chevron wells, no Liquid Glass, no scroll-edge effect). Single surface -> stays local, no canon promotion. The icon (fluid pale-blue marble ribbons on #1B5BFF squircle) is brand context only; not digested as an icon here per Workflow-A-only scope.
